sources.title: Nani Qwen 3.5 2B - ethereum.org
sources.snippet: Nani Qwen 3.5 2B is a fine-tuned Qwen3.5-2B language model for crypto wallet tool calling, trained with LoRA on roughly 2,000 examples covering 103 blockchain tools. It is designed to resolve ENS names, check balances, execute swaps, and perform other wallet operations as structured tool calls, and is distributed as open GGUF weights for local inference.
